# garage_keys (Data Source)

List all Garage access keys.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "garage_keys" "all" {}

output "key_names" {
  value = data.garage_keys.all.keys[*].name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `keys` (Attributes List) List of access keys. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--keys))

<a id="nestedatt--keys"></a>
### Nested Schema for `keys`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Key creation timestamp.
- `expiration` (String) Expiration date.
- `expired` (Boolean) Whether the key has expired.
- `id` (String) Access key ID.
- `name` (String) Friendly name of the key.
